mapping_boundary: The provider raw-ID mapping is verified. Applying it to the course keras_slices_data derivative assumes that its export preserved the original IDs; that assumption has not been independently verified.

provider_source.live_verification_performed_by: Codex auxiliary agent; read-only HTTP retrieval

derivative_evidence.course_statement: Lists keras_slices_data as 2D data under HipMRI_Study_open beside the 3D MRI and labels and names the anatomy categories.
derivative_evidence.local_download_script: download_HipMRI_2D.cmd:21; scp copies the course keras_slices_data directory without a local relabeling step
limitations: The download script alone is not evidence of successful transfer or file integrity.
No inspected exporter, publisher no-remap statement, or per-file comparison to the provider volumes establishes unchanged IDs in the current derivative.
Observed ID set 0 through 5 does not prove tissue meaning or absence of remapping.

reporting_policy: Keep numerical IDs on historical plots. Any provider tissue name applied to derivative results must retain the no-remap assumption. ID1 or macro Dice is not the ID5 target score. No mask rewrite or relabeling is authorized.
